# ghost/ham-test

Ham Test (F-Droid): study for the US amateur radio exams. Open the Technician, General or Extra question pool, read a question, answer it and see the right answer. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/ham-test
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/ham-test open_quiz --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/ham-test get_question --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/ham-test answer --device <serial> --param choice=<choice>
ghost skill run ghost/ham-test next_question --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_quiz`: Open the Technician ham radio quiz
- `get_question`: What is the current ham radio question?
- `answer`: Answer B in the ham radio quiz
- `next_question`: Next ham radio question
